properties.html:
Which of the following inferences can be drawn from the information given ?

With today’s technology, roughly half of the tasks that people do can be automated. That’s a staggering figure. But just as interesting, and maybe even more important, is that only 5% of jobs can be entirely automated.
Inferences:
I. A great number of jobs in the future are going to undergo changes because of automation.
II. There is likely to be mass unemployment due to automation.
III. People will adapt to the changes in tasks brought about by automation.
IV. Only a small percentage of jobs will be lost owing to automation.
